newsitem.title: USA: Spieker Properties to sell properties.
newsitem.headline: Spieker Properties to sell properties.

text.p: Spieker Properties Inc Friday said it sold retail properties and signed definitive contracts to sell six additional retail projects to Pacific Retail Trust for a total of $106.5 million.

In a statement, Spieker said it expects a total gain on the nine sales to be approximately $25 million, or $0.59 a share, when all of the properties are transferred to PRT according to the terms of the individual purchase contracts.

The three assets sold generated proceeds of $45 million and a gain on sale of approximately $10 million. Five of the six remaining assets will be purchased by Pacific Retail before May 1, 1997, on dates to be specified by Spieker, with the final property to be transferred by December 31, 1997.
